_note: DRAFT — hand-authored device-map for the Clarett 2Pre (Thunderbolt), paired with fcp-alsa-map-clarett-2pre.json for use with fcp-server. fcp-server loads this from file (fcp_devmap_read_from_file) so it can create controls when the device's own DEVMAP_READ (0x80000d) is unavailable or silent. It is NOT a substitute for the device-provided devmap: offsets/types are carried from the snd-clarett driver and are subject to the caveats in _todo. Replace with the /tmp/fcp-devmap-clarett-2pre-*.json dump once DEVMAP_READ works.
_schema: structs.<STRUCT>.members.<name> = { offset:int, type:string, notify-device:int, notify-client:int, array-shape?:[int] }. type is a scalar (bool|uint8|uint16|uint32|int8|int16) or a nested struct name (dotted paths accumulate offsets). device-specification.physical-{inputs,outputs}[] = { name, controls: { <control_type>: { index:int, member:string } } } binds a per-channel control to an APP_SPACE member; the read offset is member.offset + index*width (server/control-utils.c), and index+1 fills the %d in the alsa-map control name.
_provenance: Offsets from the snd-clarett driver (clarett_main.c / clarett_mixer.c) and spec/clarett-control-plane.md: air @ 174+i, mode @ 166+i, output gains @ {32,33,36,37}, master mute @ 24, dim @ 73 (several trace-confirmed). Clean-room: authored from our own interface facts, not any vendor devmap.
_todo: Replace wholesale with the device-provided devmap once DEVMAP_READ answers.
versionStageRelease.offset is a PLACEHOLDER (real firmware-version location unknown).

air/instrument use the config WRITE offsets (174+i / 166+i); on the TB Clarett these read back 0 (appspace does not mirror NVRAM preamp state — config-ownership finding), so initial/notified reads will show 0 until a real read location is found. Writes are trace-confirmed to manifest.

outputVolume is modelled as a stride-1 array at 32 with shape [6] so indices 0,1,4,5 land on the real gains 32,33,36,37 (34,35 are an unmapped gap). Consequence: the alsa-map names come out Line 1/2/5/6 rather than 1..4 — a cosmetic artifact of the sparse layout, to be fixed with the real devmap.
Output mute offsets are not yet captured, so output mute is omitted here (and from the alsa-map).
notify-client masks are guesses (the TB device does not expose the FCP notification word; the driver relays a wildcard ~0).

air._note: per-input air @ 174+i; WRITE offset, reads 0 on TB Clarett (see _todo)

instrument._note: per-input Inst/Line mode @ 166+i; WRITE offset, reads 0 on TB Clarett (see _todo)

outputVolume._note: monitor/output attenuation code 0..127; real gains at indices 0,1,4,5 (32,33,36,37)
